data.name: Hadria
data.gender_notes: Hadria is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Latin, Hadria means 'strong, enduring, diligent'. It is derived from Hadrius, which means 'boundary, limit'. In ancient Rome, Hadria was a city located on the Adriatic Sea, hence the name's association with strength, endurance, and the sea. The name Hadria carries the meaning “Strong, Enduring, Diligent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Hadria usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, enduring, diligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of steadfastness and perseverance in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Hadria belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Enduring, Diligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hadria total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: הדריה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הדריה הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו עושר וגדולה, יופי ותהילה. הוא מורכב מהמילים 'הדר' שפירושו כבוד, גדולה ויופי, וסיומת 'יה' שפירושו אלוהים. השם הדריה משמש לעתים קרובות להתייחס לנשים שגדלות להיות בעלות עושר פנימי וגדולה רוחנית.

in_greek.name: Αδρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αδρία έχει τις ρίζες του στην ελληνική γλώσσα και πιθανόν να σχετίζεται με το όνομα της Αδριατικής θάλασσας. Η λέξη 'Αδρία' πιθανόν να προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'αδρός' που σημαίνει σκοτεινός ή πλούσιος, και να αναφέρεται σε μια περιοχή ή θάλασσα που θεωρείται πλούσια και μεγάλη.

in_latin.name: Hadria
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Hadria is derived from the Latin term 'Hadrianus', which refers to someone from the city of Adria. The name Adria itself is thought to come from the Greek word 'Adrios', meaning dark or rich. In Christian tradition, the name Hadria may signify someone who is spiritually rich and great.

in_english.name: Hadria
in_english.meaning: Dark, rich and great, spiritually wealthy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hadria has its roots in both Hebrew and Greek languages. It is believed to signify someone who is spiritually wealthy, great, and rich in inner beauty. The name may be associated with the Hebrew concept of 'hadar', meaning glory or splendor, and the Greek term 'Adria', referring to the Adriatic Sea. In Christian tradition, Hadria represents a person of inner strength, spiritual richness, and great character.

Hadria can be an inspiring name for individuals seeking to embody these qualities.

The name's association with strength, endurance, and the sea can recall God's promise to be a constant source of support, just as the sea is a constant and enduring presence in our world. Furthermore, the name's roots in Latin, a language once used in the Roman Catholic Church, may resonate with some individuals who seek a connection to the spiritual traditions of Christianity. Ultimately, Hadria can serve as a powerful reminder of God's strength and endurance, which can provide comfort and inspiration in times of need.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hadria, derived from Hadria Maritima in ancient Rome, symbolizes steadfastness in faith amidst life's stormy seas. Spiritually, it represents the unwavering belief in God's guidance, even during the most challenging times.
